messages:
Alex G: Heads-up — I'm splitting the networking module into namespace-specific modules (networking-vpc, networking-k8s). Draft PR #4821 open. Main goals: hoist providers to root, remove provider blocks from child modules, and update the lockfile. Wanted a quick compat check before I push state moves.
InfraBot: PR 4821 opened by Alex G: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4821 — CI: plan queued :white_check_mark:
Ben K: quick q — are you changing provider source addresses or versions? wanna make sure downstream modules (auth, infra-apps) don't break.
Alex G: Not changing provider sources. Plan is: keep same provider source/version pins in root required_providers, regenerate root .terraform.lock.hcl, and remove provider blocks from modules so they inherit the root provider. Child modules will get a small version bump (0.2.0 -> 0.3.0) reflecting namespace split.
Samira P: Will the module paths change in state? e.g., module.networking -> module.networking-vpc ? If so we'll need `terraform state mv` instructions for staging -> prod.
Alex G: Yes. Example move I plan to run in staging (will document and run with someone):
```
terraform state mv module.networking.aws_vpc.main module.networking-vpc.aws_vpc.main
terraform state mv module.networking.aws_subnet.public[0] module.networking-vpc.aws_subnet.public[0]
```
I'll keep resource addresses identical except the module prefix.
Eli M: Lockfile note — after hoisting required_providers to root, we should regenerate `.terraform.lock.hcl` using the workspace that matches target platform. Recommend `TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR` cleared and run `terraform init -upgrade` in each workspace. Also pin the provider versions in the root `required_providers` block to avoid drift.
Nora S: CI heads-up: our repo plan job fails if lockfile changes without a `chore/lockfile` PR label. Add that to avoid noisy failures in other PRs.
Ben K: Can you add a short runbook for the state mv steps + backout? I can pair on prod run. proposed slot: Thu 10:00 PT. Works for others?
Samira P: Thu 10 works for me. LGTM on the approach. small nit: child modules that still rely on aliased providers need a short compatibility shim or update calls to `providers = { aws = aws }` removed.
Alex G: Good catch — I'll scan for `providers = {` usages and add a migration script that lists modules needing a manual tweak. I'll also add a `plan-only` run in prod that checks for drift before any state move.
InfraBot: CI: plan succeeded for branch alex/module-namespace-split (staging) :white_check_mark: — apply disabled until approvals met.
Alex G: Thanks all — I'll update the PR with the runbook, label it `chore/lockfile`, and ping for reviews. @Samira P would you be on the prod run with me? :thumbsup:
Samira P: Yup — I'll be there. Please include the exact `terraform` binary version in the runbook (we're on 1.5.6 in prod).
Eli M: Minor add: after the split, update the module registry entries and terraform-docs generation so examples point to new module names.
Nora S: I'll update CI rule to exempt PRs with `chore/lockfile` label from the block that was failing earlier.
Alex G: Perfect — plan is: finish PR updates today, run staging state mv tomorrow, prod on Thu 10 with Samira & Ben. Posting the runbook in PR in 10m.
